goal: Fill the empty NETWORK tab and track employer outcomes with a separate local CLI: validate real contacts (no invented people), deterministic status/follow-up updates, outreach drafts built only from approved networking-allowed resume language, CLI-backed application outcomes, and a counts-only weekly report. Network access stays separate from qualification (BLUEPRINT section 136).
acceptance_conditions: network-add requires an https How_Found link or KNOWN_PERSONALLY with Notes, validates Relationship/Purpose enums and Linked_Job_ID against JOBS, refuses duplicates by Contact_ID, link, or name+company, and emits exactly the 13-column NETWORK row and the live 9-column LOG row.

network-update rejects TO_CONTACT as a target, reopening CLOSED contacts, backwards dates, and a repeated same-day event; follow-up dates are deterministic (SENT +7, REPLIED +3, CALL_DONE +7, REFERRED +14, NO_REPLY/CLOSED blank).

network-draft uses only approved bullets whose every claim is human-approved and allows networking, quotes the bullet text exactly (first-person verb only), stays at or under 120 words, and fails with DRAFT_TOO_LONG instead of trimming.
record-outcome emits the live 10-column APPLICATIONS row and a LOG row, keeps existing Outcome evidence, and never emits a JOBS change.
weekly-report reports counts and follow-ups due only; no scores or percentages.
The CLI imports nothing that can send, browse, or call out, and the released run CLI is unchanged.
Runbook and config document the commands, the contact JSON, and the NETWORK headers; runbook command lines use POSIX continuation.
review_requirements: STOP after one PR is opened. Do not merge until Bora obtains a fresh independent read-only SAFE review.
stop_conditions: Any need to change the run CLI, resume QA gates, matcher, qualification, pursuit decisions, Candidate Truth, approved resume language, renderer, or cloud adapter.
Any need to send messages, automate or scrape LinkedIn, or write Drive/Sheets from this engineering PR.
Any need for scoring, automatic contact discovery, or automatic bullet selection.
human_approval_requirements: Bora retains merge authority, all Ledger/Drive writes (including writing the NETWORK header row at release), every contact added, every message sent, and every application decision.
